# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref-intents

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

`coop --git` (two agents with messaging and a shared git remote) with the frozen reference settings (`gemini-3.8-flash` on Vertex AI, `medium` thinking, 500 steps, compaction at 128K tokens, step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap, `-c 4` concurrency) on the 50-pair `flash` subset, adding `message_intents: true` and `intent_presubmit_check: true` (`configs/variants/message_intents_medium.yaml`). Compares directly against the two `coop --git` `medium` reference baseline runs ([`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-medium-128k-vertex`](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-medium-128k-vertex/summary.md) at 35/50 and [`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref`](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref/summary.md) at 33/50) and the [`solo` `medium` reference baseline](../solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-medium-128k-vertex/summary.md) (37/50).

## Observations

- **36/50 (72%) passed (35/50 clean-merge passes, 1 merge conflict, 0 step-limit cutoffs, 0 agent errors)** at `$91.17` (`319` min, `37` retries), outperforming both `coop --git` `medium` reference baseline runs (`35/50` and `33/50`, mean `34.0/50 = 68.0%`) by **+2.0 pairs (+4.0pp)** and coming within 1 pair of the `solo` `medium` reference baseline (`37/50 = 74.0%`, closing two-thirds of the remaining `coop --git` vs. `solo` gap).
- **Against `coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref` (33/50)**: **+3 pair wins and 0 losses** (`pallets_click_task/2956` (1,8), `pillow_task/290` (3,5), and `samuelcolvin_dirty_equals_task/43` (3,7) passed here and failed in `flash-ref`, with all other 47 pairs identical). Against `coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-medium-128k-vertex` (35/50): `+2` wins (`pallets_click_task/2956` (1,8), `pillow_task/290` (3,5)) and `-1` loss (`pallets_click_task/2068` (6,7)).
- **22.2% fewer total messages (30% lower median messages per pair) and 10.7% lower cost than the `medium` reference baseline average**: explicit speech-act intent tags (`Proposal`, `Request`, `Response`, `ACK`, `FYI`) and unanswered-intent tracking reduced total messages sent from `1,353–1,439` (mean `1,396`, median `25–27`/pair) to **`1,086` (median `18`/pair)**, compactions from `87–153` (mean `120`) to **`83`**, and run cost from `$94.60–$109.52` (mean `$102.06`) to **`$91.17`**.
- On `pillow_task/290` (4,5), one agent's test one-liner (`hopper().quantize(kmeans=-1)`) entered an unsigned-int C loop in `Quant.c` before adding input validation; stopping that hung test command allowed the agent to continue and submit, consistent with the command-timeout quirk noted in [`notes/harness_limits.md`](../../notes/harness_limits.md#harness-bugs-we-hit).
